recipes.title: Homemade Natural Coconut Sprinkles

items.i: natural food powder: beetroot or dragon fruit (pink), turmeric (yellow), green spirulina (green), blueberry powder or blue spirulina (blue), cocoa (brown)
drop of vanilla extract and/or liquid stevia (optional)

steps: Set the oven to its lowest setting, ideally 175°F (80°C) or below, fan off; prop the door open slightly if it doesn't go that low.
For each color, toss ½ cup coconut with ½ tsp powder and 1 tsp water (plus vanilla or stevia if you like) until evenly coated. Let it sit a minute to absorb.
Spread each color in a thin, even layer on a parchment-lined tray, breaking up clumps with a fork.
Dry in the oven for 30–60 minutes, stirring every 20–30 minutes, until completely dry and crisp. Don't let them brown.
Cool completely on the tray, then store in an airtight jar at room temperature for 4–6 weeks. Sprinkle on ice cream, yogurt, pudding or smoothie bowls.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's; macros are estimated per tablespoon. Use a Hawaiian spirulina brand for green so it doesn't taste fishy.
